comments.author: Nina
comments.body:
Best way to grind this skill in my opinion:

Where: Anping Scholar (China Lang) - r3 to r6 maps (7 max)
Steps:
1. browse book
2. Discover in Taiwan Southeast Landing (Same island as Anping)
3. Discover in Tamsui - Tamsui Southeast (Same island as Anping)
4. Back in Anping and report to He-Bin the discoveries
5. repeat step 1

No headache meds or port hopping needed. Use Research knowledge 1&2 (Oxford) for faster gain of skill prof for Eco skill. :)

comments.author: V_I
comments.body:
A good way to grind this and biology skills at higher levels is to:

1. Collect multiple copies of River Shark Map map from San Francisco (gives Chinese Sturgeon discovery)
2. Go to Western East Asia and discover map at the mouth of Yangtze River
3. Go to Anping, Taiwan and report the map discovery to He Bing
4. Repeat the map/reporting until you are out of maps, and go back to step 1

If anybody else has some suggestions, feel free to share them too!

wiki:
Refine effect: Fatigue Recovery with Discovery

This skill can be added to any aide by unlocking it at the Aide Academy -- see Sagres for details

Tip: it is possible to complete quests and archive maps requiring the use of this skill if you are 1-2 levels below the quest or map's listed skill requirement. However, it usually takes longer to successfully locate the discovery as a result.

Additionally, it is possible to leech this skill to complete quest/map discoveries while in fleet with others (but you must share the quest and have all quest clues OR be holding an archive map at the time when your fleetmate makes the same discovery).
